name: Removal of SQLite Authority
description: After PGlite is proven correct, remove SQLite as an authority. Archive the SQLite files. Update all callers.
purpose: One source of truth, not two.
acceptanceCriteria: All callers of SQLite are identified and updated to PGlite
SQLite files are archived with timestamp to a backup location
No control-plane code references SQLite directly
Dual-read mode is disabled by default
Removal is documented in changelog and migration receipt
Archived SQLite files are restorable if needed
